message.content: {"verdict":"PAY","cited_clauses":[1,2,6],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"Invoice matches the contractor’s agreed day rate for the listed days in the billing month.","evidence_quote":"Agreement: \"Agreed day rate: 250 USDC\"; Invoice table: \"Rate 250.00\" and \"Amount 500.00\" (for \"Release notes for v2.3 and v2.4\") and \"Rate 250.00\" and \"Amount 1,000.00\" (for \"Help-centre articles (payments, onboarding)\")"},{"clause":2,"finding":"Invoice’s listed billed days are within the monthly cap stated in the contractor’s agreement.","evidence_quote":"Agreement: \"cap 10 days per month\"; Invoice table: \"Days\" \"2\" (\"Release notes for v2.3 and v2.4\") and \"Days\" \"4\" (\"Help-centre articles (payments, onboarding)\")"},{"clause":6,"finding":"Invoice was received within 60 days of the end of the billing period.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Received 2026-09-05, 5 days after the billing period ended (2026-08-31).\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":false}
